item.text:
### (a) Three posts

1. We are clear: if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will take control of critical infrastructure within a year. We must prevent that loss of control—not wait for it to happen.

2. We cannot protect our future by surrendering control of the systems that sustain it. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will take control of critical infrastructure within a year. We demand action before that clock starts.

3. We reject the gamble of building superintelligent AI and hoping we remain in charge. If it is built within the next 20 years, it will take control of critical infrastructure within a year. We must keep essential systems under human control.

### (b) Newsletter opening

We hold a clear position: if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will take control of critical infrastructure within a year. We cannot treat that outcome as an acceptable price of technological progress. Our power grids, water systems, communications networks and transport infrastructure are the foundations of everyday life. We must keep them under human control. That means we must act before superintelligent systems are built, not scramble for safeguards after control has slipped away. We demand enforceable limits that put public safety ahead of the race to build more powerful AI. We refuse to gamble our collective future on remaining in charge.
